comments.author: Beomi
comments.body:
==============
Epic Biography (Michelangelo)
==============

Mineral Purchase Order X 5: Reward of the 1st Chapter
Master's Tailoring Tool X 2: Reward of the 2nd Chapter
Artist's Forging Tools Making Techniques X 1: Reward of the 3rd Chapter
The Lives X 1: Reward of the 4th Chapter

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Strategy:

Chapter 1 “To Rome”
Rome → (Number of sailing days 60 days or more) Rome

Chapter 2 "Colossus"
Florence → Pisa (Delivery available) → (Number of sailing days: 60 days or more) Deliver 50 marbles in Florence
Marble can be purchased at Athens/Salonika
When no event occurs in Florence, enter or exit any building.

Chapter 3 “Genesis”
Rome → Rome Church

Chapter 4 "The Last Judgment"
Rome → Venice → Rome Church (Delivery available) → (Number of sailing days over 60 days) Rome Church
Deliver 20 pieces of lapis lazuli at Rome
Lapis lazuli can be purchased in Hormuz (Requires investment 180k), Sevastopol (16th century 3rd through 5th period; World Clock set to one of those periods or or Adept of Ages title/Age effect (16th century) EX gear required)

Handicraft skill rank upper limit 20 → 21

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?TheLivesOfHeros%2FMichelangelo
(Pardon the above guide being a little rough; I will try to clean it up a little later on. Cheers.)

comments.author: CABlakeC
comments.body: Alternatively, for getting the lapis lazuli in Chapter 4, both Dungeon : Pyramids of Giza and Dungeon : Karnak & Luxor Temples dungeons drop them, which are not only close by but are relatively easy to do. Of course not everyone has access to them, and it might take you a couple of runs to get the amount you need, but it is something to consider.
